youtube.title: Waiting On God? Christmas Eve Prayer Before Sleep | Psalm 130:5-6 KJV
youtube.text:
It's Christmas Eve. Waiting on something tonight? This is for you.

"I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope. My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning." Psalm 130:5-6 (KJV)

Fall asleep to the Word: Psalms 125–150, KJV, read slowly: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2V6mjKBs0yo

Type amen, and send this to someone who can't sleep.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.

#NightPrayer #BibleVersesForSleep #KJV #BlessedPrayers #ChristmasPrayer #shorts
